## Preview before you publish {#publish-flow}

::: {.sa-scene}
::: {#publish-diagram}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 9
%%{init: {"htmlLabels": false, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart LR
  A["Run local preview"] --> B["Check rendered links"] -->|Verified| C["Publish to main"]
  class A sa-preview
  class B sa-check
  class C sa-publish
```
:::

::: {.sa-note-slot}
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="check"}
Open the preview and follow the links a learner will use.
:::
::: {.sa-current-note data-sa-beat="publish"}
Push the verified change to `main`.
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}

  "labels":{"verified":"L_B_C_0"},
  "initial":{"show":["preview"]},
  "steps":[
    {"beat":"check","state":{"show":["preview","check","verify"],"focus":["check","verify"]}},
    {"beat":"publish","state":{"focus":["publish","push","verified"]}}
  ]
}
</script>
```
